brief:
Israeli media reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu committed to Jared Kushner that he will carry out the Trump administration's Gaza plan and allow humanitarian aid into the territory. The pledge came amid growing American doubts about Israeli intentions and escalating Israeli violations, Shehab Wire reported.

The nature of Trump's Gaza proposal and the specific commitments Netanyahu made regarding aid delivery were not detailed in the Israeli coverage.
dek: Israeli media reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu committed to Jared Kushner that he will carry out the Trump administration's Gaza plan and allow humanitarian aid into the territory.
title: Netanyahu pledges to Kushner he will implement Trump's Gaza plan
